source_feature.provider: Purdue University GIS, BuildingShapesZip4 FeatureServer layer 0
source_feature.name: Franklin Levering Cary Quadrangle (NE)
source_feature.measurement_method: Transform the authoritative footprint ring using the repository's documented local latitude/longitude approximation; preserve ring topology.

vertical_fields.interpretation: Five levels are used. Extrution=48 is retained as an uninterpreted integer because the field has no unit or semantic metadata.

vertical.height_source: Indiana 2013 NDHM tile, 5-ft GSD; 366 pixels within Feature 638 footprint, p90=52.015 and p95=52.558 native units. If interpreted as US survey feet, these are about 15.85-16.02 m.
vertical.height_unit_status: NDHM values are native and retained in the measurement report; the GeoTIFF horizontal CRS is US survey feet, but raster vertical units are not explicitly declared. Meter conversion is an estimate, not surveyed height.
vertical.roof_form: longitudinal gable; the cross-building NDHM profile has higher central bands than outer bands. Exact eaves and pitch remain estimated

additional_sources.use: Cary overview identifies Northeast as one of four outer buildings renovated in 2007 and records suite renovation; no individual elevation dimensions.
Current oblique aerial illustrates Cary roof pitch, brick color, gables, and window character; image covers the whole quad and is not a CQNE-specific survey.
Official Cary image supports general brick, stone, and window character only; it depicts the complex entrance rather than a verified CQNE elevation.

additional_sources.provider: Indiana 3DEP LiDAR products hosted by Purdue GDSL/iDiF and Indiana Geographic Information Office open-data bucket
additional_sources.source_date: 2011-2013 program; exact acquisition date not stated in tile metadata
additional_sources.measurement_method: Mask 5-ft GSD raster cell centers with Purdue GIS Feature 638 transformed to EPSG:2966; NDHM represents object height above underlying ground. 366 cells intersect. Native quantiles and unit uncertainty are recorded in ndhm_measurement.json.
additional_sources.use: 5-ft sampled height distribution and cross-section. Peak estimate is interpreted as 16.0 m only if native values are US survey feet; vertical units are not explicit in the GeoTIFF.

additional_sources.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
additional_sources.use: Historical database says Cary Hall Northeast is the second building of the quad and dates its existence from 1931; direct HTML was blocked by the site challenge.

additional_sources.provider: Purdue e-Archives, Purdue Buildings and Campus Scenes
additional_sources.use: 1950s general Cary exterior photograph; historical context only, not attributed to CQNE.

uncertainty: GIS plan footprint and reported 5 levels are used; Extrution=48 is not used because its semantics and units are undocumented.
Height is estimated from a 2013 NDHM at 5-ft grid spacing. Raster vertical units are not explicitly declared, so the 16.0 m estimate remains conditional.
Exact CQNE facade bays, entrance location, roof pitch, and material course dimensions remain unverified; generic facade rhythm is schematic.
The official oblique aerial depicts the Cary complex collectively and does not isolate the northeast wing.

validation.status: Blender 4.5.15 reopen/render passed; fresh independent grade pending
geometry_edits: Replaced the source single-extrusion mass with the same GIS feature outline, five window rows, floor courses, and a longitudinal gable guided by NDHM cross-section; removed unsupported projecting roof bays and entry marker.
